response.justification: Strong senior fullstack profile with well over the required 6 years of experience, including recent, directly relevant work in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and — notably — current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks), which is a rare and explicitly required skill. Deep testing culture (TDD, built his own test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/testing courses) aligns well with the testing-framework requirement, and the CS degree plus broad multi-language background (Java, C/C++, Swift, D, PHP) fits the polyglot expectation. Main gaps are the absence of Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin, and PostgreSQL by name, and a heavy tilt toward backend/systems work with less explicit modern React/frontend depth — but these are learnable adjacencies rather than disqualifiers. Worth an interview focused on frontend depth and Nest.js ramp-up.
strengths: 15+ years fullstack; recent TypeScript/Node/React/AWS/MongoDB product work
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — directly matches a hard requirement
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship track record (TDD, built test frameworks, teaches workshops)
concerns: No Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest mentioned anywhere in the resume
Kotlin absent and PostgreSQL not listed; Java experience is dated (2016–2018)
Frontend depth unclear — React cited briefly, with Ember.js more prominent historically

key_factors.factor: Missing core stack items (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
